SELECT s.name AS station_name,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id IS NOT NULL AND t.end_station_id <> t.start_station_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_ended_elsewhere
FROM trip t
JOIN station s ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name
ORDER BY pct_ended_elsewhere DESC, s.name;
